cohort: The study evaluated 1714 women enrolled in the ACCESS IUS multicenter, Phase 3, open-label clinical trial of the Liletta levonorgestrel 52 mg IUS who had successful placement and at least one follow-up assessment.
finding: IUS expulsion occurs in less than 4% of users over the first 6 years, mostly within the first year, and is more likely among obese and parous women.
mod_finding: Among parous women, having ever had a cesarean delivery decreased the odds of IUS expulsion compared to parous women who only experienced vaginal deliveries.
